name: Villagers Have Last Names
description: Babies born in the village and the village's founders get a last name after their first name, from the game's own list of 50 last names (Akikai, Alosaka, Awanata ... Wikimak) -- a list the game has always carried but never used, and the one Virtual Villagers 6 and 7 later used for villagers' last names. A baby takes its father's or its mother's last name by the rule chosen in Repair Saves & Logs (Last names come from: from the father, from the mother, 50:50, or a random one of the last names the village has ever used); without a rule recorded, a baby takes its father's last name (the village's default is from the father). A villager can also have a rule of their own for their children (Each villager's own rule): from the father, from the mother, 50:50, a random last name from the list, which gives each child -- twins and triplets too -- its own random draw from the game's list, every name equally likely, or a random one of the village's existing last names. A villager's own rule always beats the village's; when both parents have one and they disagree, a coin toss for each child picks whose. Villagers who arrive through an island event get no last name, because theirs would not be their family's. Only villagers named from now on get one: villagers who already have names keep them. The last name is part of the name the game stores, so it shows wherever the name does and stays in the save even if this patch is later removed. Heathens get a random last name of their own from the same list: a new Heathen as the game makes them, and a Heathen with none the first time the patched game loads the village. Each Heathen's is one nobody in the village has used (living or dead, tribe or Heathen) while the list has one; only when all 50 are taken do Heathens share a last name, and a shared name never makes them family. A Heathen who converts keeps their last name. While they are Heathens their last names are not counted among the village's existing names (Random from the existing Village Names); once converted, theirs counts like any other. **Needs no other patch.**
behavior_changes: A baby born in the village from now on (a mother's delivery: the first child, a twin or a triplet) and a new village's founders are called "<first name> <last name>": the first name is the game's own pick, and the last name is name number <family - 1> of the game's unused third list (0X4B8450), read from the running executable.

A villager the game creates any other way -- brought by an island event, a cheat or the Origins page -- keeps the game's own first name only: the companion tells a birth or a founder by the callers' return addresses on the stack, at fixed places.
A villager whose family is outside 1-50 gets no last name.

At a birth, the rule recorded by Repair Saves & Logs decides the last name (VvfpRuleLastName2): the father's, the mother's, either at random (50:50), or -- a parent's own rule "Random last name from the list" -- a name drawn at random from the game's list, or -- "Random from the existing Village Names", the village's rule or a parent's own -- one of the last names the village has ever used (the record's "used" lines, the villagers in the game at the birth, VvfpRuleLastName3, and the parents'; the game's list when there are none); every random draw is a fresh, unbiased one for each child. Each such birth adds the names it saw that the record lacks as "used" lines (only adding, through a temporary file, never for a slot it cannot tell), so a name stays ever used after its last bearer is gone.
A parent's own rule always beats the village's; parents whose own rules disagree: a fresh coin toss for each child picks the father's or the mother's.
The whole name always fits the game's own name field: the longest pairing is far below its 23 characters.

A Heathen (the Heathen allocator 0x46FB80, every Heathen the game makes: a new village's 28, Barrel O' Babies' Heathen babies, the Story / Cheat Upgrades' and the Custom Island Event's Heathens) is called "<first name> <last name>", the last name drawn at random from the game's list among the names no villager in the game, no "used" line and no "heathen" line of the village's Last Names record has; only when every name that fits is taken, one that gives no living villager's full name, else any that fits.

Right after the villager table's load (0x46FA20), each living Heathen whose name carries no last name gets one the same way (a numeral is kept after it), and a "Name changed" record (Old name, Age) goes to the Births and Conceptions log at the next save, so the logs, the Family Tree Maker and Check Saves & Logs follow them as one villager.

Each name given is kept in the village's Last Names record as a "heathen" line (one named at a load with the name, head and body they had, so a session that ends without a save gives them the same name again), only ever added to; the record is made when the village has none, never for a slot that cannot be told.

Whatever the patcher keeps for a Heathen by their name -- a custom title, a mask, a head look, an original look, a Former Heathens entry -- stays theirs: right after the load the renamed are handed, as one batch, to each of those companions that is loaded (its export VvfpVillagersRenamed), which carries its own records to the new name and writes its own file; a name two renamed Heathens shared is carried to neither, and the batch is handed over again at later loads for a file a session never rewrote.

"Random from the existing Village Names" never counts a current Heathen's last name (the villagers in the game at a birth, and Repair's names of the village); a converted Heathen keeps their name and it counts from then on.
explicit_non_changes: No executable byte is patched: the companion detours the naming routine's first instruction at run time (and the villager table's load, 0x46FA20), after verifying it, the routine's push of the list and the creators' calls to it, and changes nothing if any differs.
Villagers who already have names keep them; when a village is loaded, only a Heathen whose name carries no last name is given one.
The first names, sexes, looks and families are the game's own; the save format is unchanged.
Heathens still never count in the statistics, and a Heathen's last name never makes them anyone's relative: it is drawn, never inherited, and no parent is recorded for it.
evidence_status: static exact-build verification of the naming routines, their callers and the unused list in each executable; runtime/player confirmation pending
